name: 10706 · Hastings Hdsn, NY
findings: ZIP 10706 (Hastings Hdsn) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10706 (Hastings Hdsn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10706 (Hastings Hdsn) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
